reviews.title: Basic GPU Power cable, no issues so far
reviews.comment: I bought this cable not too long ago since I just bought a PC off the marketplace and was missing a GPU power cable. I haven't run into any issues so far, and it's pretty self-explanatory to set it up. For experienced PC builders, there might be some other more specific suggestions on what to look for, but for me personally, I would say just to make sure to do your research on making sure you have the right power cable,e and if I'm not mistaken, to check if there are name-brand specific ones for your PSU.
reviews.author: Kyle Dos

reviews.title: Great alternative to expensive custom cables for CoolerMaster PSU cables!
reviews.comment: I purchased these cables to use with a Cooler Master MWE 850 Gold V2 (Model MPE‑8501‑AFAAG‑US). Finding replacement cables for this PSU is difficult since Cooler Master no longer sells them, so I did quite a bit of research on the V1 vs. V2 pinouts. Everything I found indicated that the MWE Gold V1 and V2 use the same pin configuration, and even though this seller doesn’t explicitly list the V2 as compatible, the cables should work. After receiving them, I inspected the wiring and verified the pinouts against a known‑good OEM cable. Everything matched, so I installed them — and they worked perfectly. For the price, this is a great alternative to having custom cables made. My only reason for giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that these use 18‑gauge wire instead of 16‑gauge like the OEM cables. It’s still safe and functional, but it would be nice to see the manufacturer match the original wire gauge.
reviews.author: sonik
